user.title: IntelliKeep Setup
user.description: Configure your IntelliKeep home maintenance system.

data_description.notification_service: e.g. notify.mobile_app_my_phone — leave empty to use only persistent notifications

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one IntelliKeep instance is allowed.

not_configured.message: Configure IntelliKeep before using its actions.

task_note_not_found.message: Note {note_id} for task {task_id} was not found.

invalid_weekdays.message: Invalid weekday value(s): {weekdays}. Use mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat or sun.

cannot_delete_completed.message: Completed tasks keep their history and leave this list 30 days after completion. To delete one, use the IntelliKeep panel.

load_sample_data.name: Load sample data
load_sample_data.description: Adds sample home maintenance tasks, for trying IntelliKeep out.

frequency.name: Frequency
frequency.description: How often the task repeats: the unit of Repeat every. The value "custom" from version 1.x, with custom_days_interval, still works and is saved as daily.

repeat_interval.name: Repeat every
repeat_interval.description: Repeats every N days, weeks, months or years, in the unit set by Frequency.

schedule_anchor.name: Count next due date from
schedule_anchor.description: Completion date: a late completion moves the next one too. Original due date: keeps a fixed calendar.

icon.name: Icon
icon.description: Icon shown next to the task.

weekdays.name: Weekdays
weekdays.description: Days of the week a weekly task repeats on. With no days, it repeats every 7 days after each completion.

linked_entity_ids.name: Linked entities
linked_entity_ids.description: Home Assistant entities the task belongs to. The area and device filters in the panel use them.

notify_days_before.name: Notify days before
notify_days_before.description: How many days before the due date the reminder is sent.

notify_on_overdue.name: Notify when overdue
notify_on_overdue.description: Send a notification when the task becomes overdue.

complete_task.name: Complete task
complete_task.description: Marks a task as done. A recurring task gets its next occurrence.

task_id.name: Task ID
task_id.description: ID of the task to complete.

reopen_task.name: Reopen task
reopen_task.description: Reopens a completed task and undoes the completion: its record leaves the history, and for a recurring task the next occurrence it created is removed unless it was already edited, noted or completed.

task_id.name: Task ID
task_id.description: ID of the task to reopen.

performed_by.name: Reopened by
performed_by.description: Who reopened the task, shown in the activity log.

delete_task.name: Delete task
delete_task.description: Permanently deletes a task, with its notes and history.

task_id.name: Task ID
task_id.description: ID of the task to delete.

update_task.name: Update task
update_task.description: Changes fields of an existing task. Fields left out keep their value.

task_id.name: Task ID
task_id.description: ID of the task to update.

frequency.name: Frequency
frequency.description: How often the task repeats: the unit of Repeat every. The value "custom" from version 1.x, with custom_days_interval, still works and is saved as daily.

repeat_interval.name: Repeat every
repeat_interval.description: Repeats every N days, weeks, months or years, in the unit set by Frequency.

schedule_anchor.description: Completion date: a late completion moves the next one too. Original due date: keeps a fixed calendar.

icon.name: Icon
icon.description: Icon shown next to the task.

weekdays.name: Weekdays

linked_entity_ids.name: Linked entities

notify_days_before.name: Notify days before
notify_days_before.description: How many days before the due date the reminder is sent.

notify_on_overdue.name: Notify when overdue
notify_on_overdue.description: Send a notification when the task becomes overdue.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Off closes the task without recording a completion, on opens it again. To complete a task, use Complete task.

updated_by.name: Updated by
updated_by.description: Who made the change, shown in the activity log.

add_task_note.name: Add task note
add_task_note.description: Adds a note to a task.

task_id.name: Task ID
task_id.description: ID of the task to add the note to.

delete_task_note.name: Delete task note
delete_task_note.description: Deletes a note from a task.

task_id.name: Task ID
task_id.description: ID of the task that has the note.

note_id.name: Note ID
note_id.description: ID of the note to delete.

delete_all_data.name: Delete all data
delete_all_data.description: Permanently deletes every IntelliKeep task, note and completion record. Admins only.
